authoring_target: Isolated working presentations identified by absolute FullName on every region operation; reference deck inspected read-only.
reviewer_basis: Each region was rendered through PowerPoint and inspected in whole-slide context before the next region. Native text bounds, picture declarations, connector attachment, whole-slide audit and final renders were also checked.
semantic_scope: Conceptual mutual dependence of pose and map; no claim that all deployed localizers build a map.
3D map is controlled mapping A with provided sensor poses.
Pose hypotheses are 12 editable illustrative circles, not measured particles.
Recovery remains an open question; physical tests pending.
corrections: Corrected the native crop-window placement so geometric fields remain complete.
Computed repeated-column positions at a constant 218 pt step.
Serialized each raster declaration under the Scientific Illustrator tag names.
Moved algorithm-role details into editable speaker notes to enlarge the map field.

crop_gate.basis: Source nonwhite-pixel bounding boxes are fully inside the declared native picture crop windows.

visual_review.basis: Reference purple palette and Golos type, rounded white canvas, four numbered horizontal stages and editable process row; no unrelated semantic-mapping content or logo copied.
